newsitem.title: USA: KinderCare to relocate to Portland, Oregon.
newsitem.headline: KinderCare to relocate to Portland, Oregon.

text.p: KinderCare Learning Centers Inc said Tuesday it will relocate its corporate headquarters from Montgomery, Ala. to Portland, Ore. to enable the company to more effectively support the educational quality and future growth of its 1,151 child care centers.

The relocation will be carried out in several phases throughout 1997 and possibly into early 1998. The company said it has begun a search for a new headquarters site in Portland, and expects to identify a location by the end of March.

In a related strategy, the company also said it will reorganize its corporate staff. Changes include creation of a corporate development group to focus on growth opportunities, a corporate services group to manage non-financial functions, and restructuring of the Finance group.

David Johnson, chief executive, and a resident of Portland, said his decision to relocate the headquarters and reorganize management was made in consultation with the company's majority shareholder, Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co.
